title: OP SCRIPT Revenge Hub
features:
Features

+ Main tab

* Tp to nearest Tree
* Auto Bunny Foot Farm (A bit buggy)
* Auto Tp to safe place (when your health is low)
* Auto Click
* Auto Click Delay
* Cook all meat
* Hitbox Expander
* Various ESPs

+ Player Tab

* Walkspeed changer
* Jump Power changer
* Gravity Changer
* Hip Height (character height) changer
* Fast Buttons
* noclip

+ Bring Tab

* Various Bring functions (logs, raw & cooked food, fuel canisters...more)

+ Teleport Tab

* TP to campfire
* TP to scrapper
* TP to caves
* TP to kids

+ Misc

* Click Tp
* Auto Set Day
* Auto Set Clean Weather
* Remove Fog, Bushes, rocks, flowers
